capabilities.title: Read current and maximum hit points
capabilities.description: Observe coherent current/maximum HP and boost/bar interpretation after a complete server update. This outcome excludes warning audio, full HUD and live-session acceptance.

capabilities.title: Read successive message occurrences
capabilities.description: Read ordered incoming message occurrences, including identical adjacent text and the clear-topline control. Full recall, notes, chat routing and audio are separate future outcomes.

capabilities.title: Answer a server key request
capabilities.description: Read a server prompt and answer once with the original request identity and selected key, then return to the parent input context.

capabilities.title: Cancel a server key request
capabilities.description: Cancel a pending key request with Escape and emit exactly one zero-key reply for that request, restoring the parent input context. Other request owners have separate cancellation rules.

capabilities.title: Choose advertised server
capabilities.description: Select a metaserver entry and preserve its endpoint; ping results may update without changing the selected server.

capabilities.title: Enter an explicit server
capabilities.description: Enter host and effective port manually or from startup arguments; no hostname-to-IP canonicalization of credential identity.

capabilities.title: Cancel manual server entry
capabilities.description: Escape cancels manual entry and follows the startup caller exit path without contacting a guessed/default host.

capabilities.title: Connect to selected endpoint
capabilities.description: Complete TCP contact, version/protocol negotiation, verification and setup before exposing character selection.

capabilities.title: Read contact or setup failure
capabilities.description: Present DNS/socket/timeout, ban, incompatible-version and verification/setup failure distinctly; release the failed connection and allow only the baseline retry/exit transitions.

capabilities.title: Enter account identity
capabilities.description: Interactive account name has 15 payload bytes and live trimming; CLI/config producers retain their own boundaries and server validation.

capabilities.title: Exit account entry
capabilities.description: Escape from account-name entry exits startup; it does not silently authenticate a stored identity.

capabilities.title: Enter private login password
capabilities.description: Accept private password bytes up to 15 interactive payload bytes; empty input retries, no normalization, history or diagnostic capture.

capabilities.title: Return from password to account name
capabilities.description: Escape from password entry returns to account-name selection without a login packet.

capabilities.title: Reject an unrepresentable credential
capabilities.description: For server_protocol >= 2 reject login or password change containing star before XOR42 creates a NUL; preserve private draft for correction and send no partial packet.

capabilities.title: Authenticate an existing account
capabilities.description: Verify credentials and receive account/character overview; success is server-confirmed, never inferred from sending login.

capabilities.title: Create a new account
capabilities.description: A valid unused account name and password follow server new-account handling; account flags/validation and resulting overview remain authoritative.

capabilities.title: Recover from rejected authentication
capabilities.description: Wrong password, invalid name or server rejection shows failure and returns to the appropriate retry owner or exits when RETRY_LOGIN is disabled; clear invalid defaults as baseline requires.

capabilities.title: Restore saved login secret
capabilities.description: Look up the exact server spelling/effective port/account byte tuple in Linux Secret Service or Windows Credential Manager; invalid or missing secret returns to private manual entry with no hidden legacy-file fallback.

capabilities.title: Save an authenticated secret
capabilities.description: After successful authentication save exact credential bytes in the OS provider; independent SV identity metadata contains no secret or reversible representation.

capabilities.title: Continue with a session-only credential
capabilities.description: Unavailable, locked, refused or failed credential provider leaves an explicit unsaved session-only credential; do not report storage success or fall back to legacy password files.

capabilities.title: Read account information
capabilities.description: Read account validation and account information from the account-options surface; Escape returns to the options parent.

capabilities.title: Submit password change
capabilities.description: Enter old/new/repeated private passwords, then submit old/new once; successful send immediately updates session/vault secret under the approved policy, separately from later server success messages.

capabilities.title: Cancel password change
capabilities.description: Escape at old, new or repeat editor returns to account options without sending or replacing the saved credential.

capabilities.title: Handle password change rejection
capabilities.description: Keep send failure distinct from server wrong-password, length or account-write failure; report unsaved provider result without claiming that the server accepted the change.

capabilities.title: Read available characters and slots
capabilities.description: Render the terminated server character list with names, modes, levels, race/class and available location; preserve server flags, total/dedicated limits and first-run restrictions.

capabilities.title: Enter an existing character
capabilities.description: Select an owned slot by letter and complete login status handling before starting play; command-line/default character selection must resolve identically.

capabilities.title: Start ordinary character creation
capabilities.description: N chooses an available ordinary slot; name acceptance starts birth only when server permits creation.

capabilities.title: Start slot-exclusive character creation
capabilities.description: E selects dedicated creation when exclusive_ok and not first run; carry dedicated IDDC/PvP mode into completed birth.

capabilities.title: Name a new character
capabilities.description: Use 15-byte live-trim/plus-prefix editor; empty entry generates a random suggestion and remains in editor, nonempty accepts, plus prefix requests reincarnation. Server Trim_name and ownership checks remain authoritative.

capabilities.title: Cancel a new character name
capabilities.description: Escape returns to character overview with no character-login submission.

capabilities.title: Recover from rejected character choice
capabilities.description: Server rejects forbidden/duplicate/unowned character name with retry-login or exit policy; never expose a partially entered live session.

capabilities.title: Swap characters
capabilities.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 1. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

capabilities.title: Insert character before another
capabilities.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 2. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

capabilities.title: Append character after another
capabilities.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 3. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

capabilities.title: Cancel first reorder selection
capabilities.description: Escape at first slot selection discards the unfinished reorder and returns to overview without PKT_LOGIN reorder bytes.

capabilities.title: Cancel second reorder selection
capabilities.description: Escape at second slot selection discards the unfinished reorder and returns to overview without PKT_LOGIN reorder bytes.

capabilities.title: Quit from character overview
capabilities.description: Q or Ctrl-Q exits the overview through the baseline connection cleanup without selecting a character.

capabilities.title: Choose sex
capabilities.description: Complete the sex choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Choose race
capabilities.description: Complete the race choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Choose trait
capabilities.description: Complete the trait choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Choose class
capabilities.description: Complete the class choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Choose body modification
capabilities.description: Complete the body choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Distribute starting stats
capabilities.description: Complete the stats choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Choose character mode
capabilities.description: Complete the mode choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

capabilities.title: Quit character creation
capabilities.description: Q or Ctrl-Q terminates creation through baseline quit/retry handling without sending a completed character.

capabilities.title: Reuse saved birth choices
capabilities.description: Load character DNA from the shared baseline filename; missing/invalid or incompatible choices cannot bypass legality checks. Preserve # selection and percent auto-reincarnation semantics.

capabilities.title: Persist completed birth choices
capabilities.description: Save accepted birth DNA in the shared user-resource namespace using baseline filename/format; report write failure truthfully, preserving previously valid data.

capabilities.title: Enter play with completed creation
capabilities.description: Only after all required creation steps and dedicated mode adjustments submit final identity, stats, options, geometry and graphics/resource handshake and wait for play acknowledgement.

capabilities.title: Read and acknowledge MOTD
capabilities.description: Present received MOTD; acknowledge via a nonzero key after the baseline wait, returning to the startup/play-handshake owner before Net_start; gameplay input is not yet enabled.

capabilities.title: Enter a live session
capabilities.description: After selected or created character play acknowledgement, publish coherent identity/map and load this character profile and macro layers before enabling gameplay input.

capabilities.title: Apply the session profile and input layers
capabilities.description: Load independent SV config/options/history and shared resource/macro files in baseline precedence; character/race/trait/class/form overrides must affect actual commands. Missing resource fallback retains requested identity under resolved policy.

capabilities.title: Complete startup server file transfer
capabilities.description: Process server file init/data/end/check/ack/error and reload required Lua/data before dependent play; preserve file ownership and failure rather than using stale scripts as successful startup.

capabilities.title: Handle server or transport disconnect
capabilities.description: Invalidate session requests, macros and stale input; present reason and take baseline reconnect/exit branch without dispatching pending gameplay or fabricating replies.

capabilities.title: Reconnect through a fresh session
capabilities.description: Retry login after permitted disconnect/client quit using a fresh session generation; reauthenticate and reselect character without retaining old world or request state.

capabilities.title: Follow server portal relogin
capabilities.description: SERVER_PORTALS control supplies host, port, account, password, character, reason and delay; treat credentials as transient private control, reset old session and use target identity for reconnect.

capabilities.title: Quit and release the live session
capabilities.description: Ctrl-Q or window close follows the live quit owner, saves owned profile/history and releases network/input resources; optional save-chat child returns correctly.

capabilities.title: Observe death or retirement transition
capabilities.description: Killed by, Committed suicide and Retired quit reasons enter the appropriate death/tomb or ghost/session handling, clear pending actions and preserve final review data until its owner closes.

capabilities.title: Leave the tomb screen
capabilities.description: Escape/q/Q/Ctrl-Q leaves the tomb through its shutdown owner and stops tomb weather/effects; redraw does not repeat disconnect.

capabilities.title: Review final character state
capabilities.description: Shutdown review exposes character, inventory, equipment and message/chat history child surfaces and restores the shutdown parent on child close.

capabilities.title: Confirm suicide
capabilities.description: Default-no confirmation followed by literal @ submits Send_suicide exactly once; server result controls death transition.

capabilities.title: Decline suicide
capabilities.description: Decline or Escape first confirmation, or any second key except @, returns to gameplay without Send_suicide.

capabilities.title: Walk one step
capabilities.description: Use command_dir or direction prompt; send one walk intent, observe authoritative movement or blocked result.

capabilities.title: Run in a direction
capabilities.description: Send run intent and observe server-controlled continuation/stop; queued movement is not optimistic local position.

capabilities.title: Stay and pick up
capabilities.description: Send stay with normal pickup semantics; server pickup confirmation is a separate owner.

capabilities.title: Pick up one item
capabilities.description: Send stay-one, preserving its distinction from ordinary stay and automatic stay.

capabilities.title: Rest
capabilities.description: Send rest; show server resting state and stop only through baseline interruption/results.

capabilities.title: Search once
capabilities.description: Send a single search action and show server result.

capabilities.title: Toggle searching
capabilities.description: Send toggle-search and show authoritative search state.

capabilities.title: Use stairs upward
capabilities.description: Send upward stair action; server changes location or reports refusal; preserve shipped escape-prefix macro.

capabilities.title: Use stairs downward
capabilities.description: Send downward stair action; server changes location or reports refusal; preserve shipped escape-prefix macro.

capabilities.title: Tunnel in a direction
capabilities.description: Use resolved direction and send tunnel; server owns obstruction and repeated action semantics.

capabilities.title: Open adjacent feature
capabilities.description: Send open with direction; observe door/chest/store entry or denial as server determines.

capabilities.title: Close adjacent feature
capabilities.description: Send close with direction and observe close or refusal.

capabilities.title: Bash adjacent feature
capabilities.description: Send bash with direction, preserving server failure and side effects.

capabilities.title: Disarm adjacent feature
capabilities.description: Send disarm with direction and preserve success/failure/trigger consequences.

capabilities.title: Cancel a navigation direction
capabilities.description: Cancel or invalid direction sends no walk/run/tunnel/open/close/bash/disarm packet; exercise each caller independently, including cancellation of nested targeting.

capabilities.title: Interrupt repeated actions
capabilities.description: Space clears repeated actions according to process_command; do not equate this with the explicit server buffer-clear command.

capabilities.title: Clear queued server commands
capabilities.description: Send_clear_buffer for right parenthesis clears server command queue without executing its contents again on redraw.

capabilities.title: Read current world location
capabilities.description: Publish world x/y/z, town/sector colors and location labels coherently with absent-version defaults; transitions reset obsolete map/target state.

capabilities.title: Read movement and resting state
capabilities.description: Observe searching/resting/paralyzed state from PKT_STATE without treating client keypress as server acknowledgement.

capabilities.title: Open floor or world map
capabilities.description: Request mode 0 overview or forced world mode 1; display complete map stream and own player-sector marker.

capabilities.title: Pan the overview
capabilities.description: Navigation requests retain baseline map direction bitmask; 5/Space/r recenters, with server version and selector-scrolling gates.

capabilities.title: Inspect a world sector
capabilities.description: s toggles world-map selector; direction moves bounded sector selection and shows coordinates/distance without moving player.

capabilities.title: Leave sector selection
capabilities.description: Escape from selection clears selector while map remains active; another Escape closes map.

capabilities.title: Close the overview
capabilities.description: Escape/M exits map, clears local_map_active and restores parent with queue flush; do not resend map commands from redraw.

capabilities.title: Inspect neighbouring map panels
capabilities.description: Send_locate(5) opens panel browsing, direction sends panel movement without moving player.

capabilities.title: Restore player-centred viewport
capabilities.description: Exit locate with Escape/Space/L (normal) or W (roguelike), send Send_locate(0) and restore prior input policy.

capabilities.title: Choose a direction for an action
capabilities.description: Return mapped direction 1..9 to its caller; supplied command_dir bypasses prompt without reading another key.

capabilities.title: Use the acquired target
capabilities.description: Minus returns code 10, plus code 11, ordinary 5 returns 5; do not conflate target-required, acquired/manual and self-capable routes.

capabilities.title: Choose a target from a direction prompt
capabilities.description: Star opens hostile target child; successful selection returns 5, child cancellation returns no direction and caller must not send its action.

capabilities.title: Cancel a direction choice
capabilities.description: Escape/invalid direction returns false, with no enclosing action packet; parent owner decides whether to retry or exit.

capabilities.title: Select a hostile target
capabilities.description: Initialize Send_target(0), navigate candidates with mapped direction, accept t/5 using Send_target(5). Server target info supplies result.

capabilities.title: Select a target position
capabilities.description: p toggles manual mode and sends target 128; navigation sends 128+direction and acceptance sends 133.

capabilities.title: Cancel hostile target selection
capabilities.description: Escape/q or any unmapped non-command key exits false without a target-confirm or invented cancel packet; clear target prompt and return to caller.

capabilities.title: Acquire a friendly target
capabilities.description: Friendly command sends Send_target_friendly(0) and returns immediately; no copied hostile modal loop or false cancel obligation.

capabilities.title: Read target coordinates and description
capabilities.description: Retain original target x/y and description, render server target updates while another request is active, and clear old session target data on disconnect.

capabilities.title: Inspect entities
capabilities.description: Initialize Send_look(0) and browse directions; invalid direction bells/retries without closing; input updates do not move player.

capabilities.title: Inspect a ground grid
capabilities.description: p switches manual ground mode; l (normal) or x (roguelike) sends look 133 only in manual mode.

capabilities.title: Close inspection
capabilities.description: Escape/q clears topline and restores previous hybrid-macro policy, including after nested chat; no fabricated close packet.

capabilities.title: Answer a server direction request
capabilities.description: PKT_DIRECTION waits while screen/topline/store is busy, then returns selected direction once; keep this owner distinct from generic key requests.

capabilities.title: Cancel a server direction request
capabilities.description: Canceled Receive_direction returns without a direction reply; preserve busy-request queue and parent restoration rather than sending generic key zero.

capabilities.title: Acknowledge the final scene
capabilities.description: After terminal death/retirement display final scene until literal 0; other keys do not skip this acknowledgement. Then display tomb.

capabilities.title: Continue from tomb to final review
capabilities.description: A nonzero key other than tomb quit/dump/screenshot commands enters final review; 0 remains at tomb.

capabilities.title: Close final review
capabilities.description: Escape/Ctrl-Q leaves final-state review and continues the disconnect/relogin path.

capabilities.title: Read live character identity
capabilities.description: Read current race/class/trait/sex/mode/lives/name from the server with explicit defaults for absent older fields; do not confuse birth draft with accepted identity.

capabilities.title: Read the live game map
capabilities.description: Display authoritative cells and line batches, overlays and player position, preserving glyph identity and protocol frame boundaries; normal/big-map resize never fabricates world movement.

capabilities.title: Recover from startup transfer failure
capabilities.description: File-transfer checksum mismatch, write/read/open failure or malformed transfer fails explicitly with the defined error/ack path; dependent Lua/game setup cannot claim readiness.

capabilities.title: Return from race selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from race returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: Return from trait selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from trait returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: Return from class selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from class returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: Return from body selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from body returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: Return from stats selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from stats returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: Return from mode selection
capabilities.description: Backspace from mode returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

capabilities.title: items.read-inventory
capabilities.description: Read inventory slots with original slot identity, names/colour/inscription boundaries, count, weight, type/subtype, identification, artefact, trade and uses_dir metadata. Empty-slot updates remove visible entries; selection never derives identity from sorted display rows.

capabilities.title: items.read-equipment
capabilities.description: Read equipment at stable equipment slots, including normal/wide powers, bonuses, set/identification and direction flags; retain old-version defaults and exact source names. Final-state review uses these read-only data without enabling live commands.

capabilities.title: items.read-bag
capabilities.description: Read a selected bag and its contents using container slot plus contained slot, preserving the encoded (container+1)*SUBINVEN_INVEN_MUL+slot identity across updates, empty entries and parent closure.

capabilities.title: items.read-floor
capabilities.description: Read floor type and attributed underfoot description/visibility; absence and removal clear the right floor state without confusing floor with inventory or newest-item identities.

capabilities.title: items.pickup-accept
capabilities.description: Accept the server pickup check with default-no confirmation and send Send_stay exactly once; observe authoritative pickup/inventory updates.

capabilities.title: items.pickup-decline
capabilities.description: Decline or Escape the pickup check: no Send_stay and no generic request reply; restore the movement owner.

capabilities.title: store.enter
capabilities.description: Stage stock/action updates before STORE_INFO opens shopping; metadata defines identity, owner, active stock extent and price multiplier defaults. Opening resets the view; shrinking stock hides stale rows outside stock_num.

capabilities.title: store.read-stock
capabilities.description: Read normal and wide keyed stock, prices, quantities, pval width, attributed names and powers; only active stock extent is selectable, and local page letters resolve through store_top. Partial updates preserve other slots.

capabilities.title: store.read-actions
capabilities.description: Read server-advertised action IDs, letters, flags, cost and restrictions independently of stock. Runtime action letters take priority over local keys; missing/disabled actions are not invented.

capabilities.title: store.leave
capabilities.description: Escape/Ctrl-Q leaves the store, emits Send_store_leave through the store lifecycle, clears transient stock/last selection and restores the previous owner and macro state.

capabilities.title: store.kicked
capabilities.description: A server STORE_LEAVE closes shopping, flushes safe macro execution and clears player-store visuals; store lifecycle cleanup restores the parent and invalidates pending transactions without duplicated effects.

capabilities.title: items.select-slot
capabilities.description: Select an eligible inventory/equipment/bag slot via letter, tag digit, sole-item Enter or newest +; / switches inventory/equipment, ! selects bag when permitted. Preserve tester hooks, INVEN_FIRST/UNPREFER_SUBINVEN, charge checks, uppercase verification versus CAPS_ALT and special negative results.

capabilities.title: items.select-name
capabilities.description: Resolve @ name lookup against the caller-specific item tester, inscription precedence, matching order and permitted sources; the local 79-byte name is not sent as an item ID.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-selection
capabilities.description: Escape or rejected uppercase verification returns failure to the exact item caller and removes the temporary list; safe macro missing-item/tag/name handling flushes only according to safe_macros/abort_prompt, including command_gap and remaining tag/name bytes.

capabilities.title: items.toggle-selection-list
capabilities.description: Toggle the eligible item list without changing chosen source or item identity; redraw and updates preserve the pending selector and return owner.

capabilities.title: items.drop
capabilities.description: Select item and quantity, preserving equipped ammo, whole_ammo_stack, verified_item and !G defaults. Send_drop still receives zero when the quantity prompt is canceled; item-selector cancellation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-drop
capabilities.description: Cancel drop at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select item and quantity, preserving equipped ammo, whole_ammo_stack, verified_item and !G defaults. Send_drop still receives zero when the quantity prompt is canceled; item-selector cancellation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.drop-gold
capabilities.description: Enter a gold amount with all/space handling; nonzero sends gold, zero or canceled quantity sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-drop-gold
capabilities.description: Cancel drop-gold at each available step and restore its exact caller. Enter a gold amount with all/space handling; nonzero sends gold, zero or canceled quantity sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.wield
capabilities.description: Choose a carried item and send its stable slot to wear/wield; cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-wield
capabilities.description: Cancel wield at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a carried item and send its stable slot to wear/wield; cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.wield-secondary
capabilities.description: Choose a carried item for the secondary slot using Send_wield2; cancellation sends nothing and server version support remains explicit.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-wield-secondary
capabilities.description: Cancel wield-secondary at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a carried item for the secondary slot using Send_wield2; cancellation sends nothing and server version support remains explicit.

capabilities.title: items.take-off
capabilities.description: Select equipped item; ordinary path takes off with Send_take_off. Verified stacks on server >4.4.7.0.0.0 ask quantity and use Send_take_off_amt, including quantity zero; item cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-take-off
capabilities.description: Cancel take-off at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select equipped item; ordinary path takes off with Send_take_off. Verified stacks on server >4.4.7.0.0.0 ask quantity and use Send_take_off_amt, including quantity zero; item cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.swap
capabilities.description: Resolve @xN/@N and equipment identities to primary/secondary wield or takeoff; matching dual-wield inscriptions use Send_wield3. Cancel does not swap; all fallback branches remain distinct evidence cases.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-swap
capabilities.description: Cancel swap at each available step and restore its exact caller. Resolve @xN/@N and equipment identities to primary/secondary wield or takeoff; matching dual-wield inscriptions use Send_wield3. Cancel does not swap; all fallback branches remain distinct evidence cases.

capabilities.title: items.destroy
capabilities.description: Select item, quantity and default-no confirmation unless no_verify_destroy; preserve whole_ammo_stack and bag behavior. Zero quantity, Escape or declined confirmation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-destroy
capabilities.description: Cancel destroy at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select item, quantity and default-no confirmation unless no_verify_destroy; preserve whole_ammo_stack and bag behavior. Zero quantity, Escape or declined confirmation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.inscribe
capabilities.description: Choose item then inscription, or SPECIAL_REQ -3 selects inscription first then item. Both editors have 59-byte entry limit; wire %s and server INSCR_LEN bound differ. Cancel at either step sends nothing; accepted empty remains distinct.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-inscribe
capabilities.description: Cancel inscribe at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose item then inscription, or SPECIAL_REQ -3 selects inscription first then item. Both editors have 59-byte entry limit; wire %s and server INSCR_LEN bound differ. Cancel at either step sends nothing; accepted empty remains distinct.

capabilities.title: items.uninscribe
capabilities.description: Choose item and remove its inscription through Send_uninscribe; cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-uninscribe
capabilities.description: Cancel uninscribe at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose item and remove its inscription through Send_uninscribe; cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.autoinscribe-one
capabilities.description: Apply local ordered rules with force TRUE to one selected item, then permitted server fallback if unhandled and uninscribed. Preserve auto_inscr_off, server/chemical flags and server >4.5.5.0.0.0; this does not edit rule files.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-autoinscribe-one
capabilities.description: Cancel autoinscribe-one at each available step and restore its exact caller. Apply local ordered rules with force TRUE to one selected item, then permitted server fallback if unhandled and uninscribed. Preserve auto_inscr_off, server/chemical flags and server >4.5.5.0.0.0; this does not edit rule files.

capabilities.title: items.quaff
capabilities.description: Choose quaffable potion from allowed inventory/bag, emit Send_quaff and observe server result; empty inventory reports no potions, cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-quaff
capabilities.description: Cancel quaff at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose quaffable potion from allowed inventory/bag, emit Send_quaff and observe server result; empty inventory reports no potions, cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.read
capabilities.description: Choose scroll, parchment or readable custom object; Send_read can trigger a separate server item/spell request. Cancel/no eligible scroll sends nothing; complete the real child request before claiming this flow.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-read
capabilities.description: Cancel read at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose scroll, parchment or readable custom object; Send_read can trigger a separate server item/spell request. Cancel/no eligible scroll sends nothing; complete the real child request before claiming this flow.

capabilities.title: items.aim-wand
capabilities.description: Choose charged wand from allowed inventory/equipment then direction/target; canceled item or direction sends no aim. Empty eligible set and server failure preserve parent.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-aim-wand
capabilities.description: Cancel aim-wand at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose charged wand from allowed inventory/equipment then direction/target; canceled item or direction sends no aim. Empty eligible set and server failure preserve parent.

capabilities.title: items.use-staff
capabilities.description: Choose charged staff from allowed inventory/equipment/bag and emit Send_use; server item selection is a separate required child when requested. Cancel/no eligible staff sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-use-staff
capabilities.description: Cancel use-staff at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose charged staff from allowed inventory/equipment/bag and emit Send_use; server item selection is a separate required child when requested. Cancel/no eligible staff sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.zap-rod
capabilities.description: Choose a rod; uses_dir=0 (including old-server default) uses Send_zap, otherwise get_dir then Send_zap_dir. Preserve bag identity; canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-zap-rod
capabilities.description: Cancel zap-rod at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a rod; uses_dir=0 (including old-server default) uses Send_zap, otherwise get_dir then Send_zap_dir. Preserve bag identity; canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.refill
capabilities.description: Require an equipped light and filter torch versus oil/lantern fuel; choose item and send Send_fill. Missing light or canceled fuel choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-refill
capabilities.description: Cancel refill at each available step and restore its exact caller. Require an equipped light and filter torch versus oil/lantern fuel; choose item and send Send_fill. Missing light or canceled fuel choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.eat
capabilities.description: Choose edible food from inventory/bag and send Send_eat; empty eligible set has its own message and cancellation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-eat
capabilities.description: Cancel eat at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose edible food from inventory/bag and send Send_eat; empty eligible set has its own message and cancellation sends nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-activate

capabilities.title: items.cancel-force-stack

capabilities.title: items.split-stack

capabilities.title: items.cancel-split-stack

capabilities.title: items.stow
capabilities.description: Require a bag, choose carried item and amount with whole-stack/!G rules, then Send_si_move. Missing bag and canceled quantity send nothing.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-stow
capabilities.description: Cancel stow at each available step and restore its exact caller. Require a bag, choose carried item and amount with whole-stack/!G rules, then Send_si_move. Missing bag and canceled quantity send nothing.

capabilities.title: items.unstow

capabilities.title: items.cancel-unstow
capabilities.description: Cancel unstow at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose contained item and amount, preserving container identity; Send_si_remove only after nonzero quantity. Restore bag owner on cancellation.

capabilities.title: items.inspect
capabilities.description: Choose an eligible item and request its details with Send_observe. Retain original attributed server document and return to the invoking inventory/equipment/store/gameplay owner after perusal; item selection alone is insufficient evidence.

capabilities.title: items.cancel-inspect
capabilities.description: Cancel inspect at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose an eligible item and request its details with Send_observe. Retain original attributed server document and return to the invoking inventory/equipment/store/gameplay owner after perusal; item selection alone is insufficient evidence.

capabilities.title: items.read-newest
capabilities.description: Observe primary/secondary newest markers and supported inventory/bag identities; Receive_item_newest old byte layout versus >=4.8.1.1.0.0 i32 and secondary fallback/type preference do not merge unrelated slots.

capabilities.title: items.assign-newest
capabilities.description: Use /new (case-insensitive exact) interactive selector or case-sensitive /new <slot> branch, help/? and first-byte-only parsing. Reject invalid/empty/subinventory result at this owner despite selector availability; assignment is local and redraw-only.

capabilities.title: items.autoinscribe-all
capabilities.description: /aai or /apply_auto_inscriptions (case-insensitive exact) applies ordered rules to inventory/equipment and enabled bags without confirmation. Local-off still permits configured server fallback; preserve disabled/bag-only/regex/force overwrite rules and inscription/uninscription packets.

capabilities.title: items.server-item-answer
capabilities.description: Complete the owner selection and emit the typed reply once. ITH tester hooks include recharge, armour/weapon/no-shield/nonartefact, ID/star-ID, custom tome, rune equip-only, chemical and signed weight byte. New shape >4.5.2.0.0.0 includes th; old defaults ITH_NONE. Busy queues exact packet; bag chemical exception may enter immediately.

capabilities.title: items.server-item-cancel
capabilities.description: Escape/canceled selector returns consumed (1) without any reply; do not send key-zero or a generic request sentinel. ITH tester hooks include recharge, armour/weapon/no-shield/nonartefact, ID/star-ID, custom tome, rune equip-only, chemical and signed weight byte. New shape >4.5.2.0.0.0 includes th; old defaults ITH_NONE. Busy queues exact packet; bag chemical exception may enter immediately.

capabilities.title: items.server-spell-answer
capabilities.description: Complete the owner selection and emit the typed reply once. Receive PKT_SPELL i32 book/item; school selection returns item and spell/level semantics to Send_spell (two i16 fields). Busy surface queues the request intact.

capabilities.title: items.server-spell-cancel
capabilities.description: Escape/canceled selector returns consumed (1) without any reply; do not send key-zero or a generic request sentinel. Receive PKT_SPELL i32 book/item; school selection returns item and spell/level semantics to Send_spell (two i16 fields). Busy surface queues the request intact.

capabilities.title: combat.fire
capabilities.description: Choose direction/acquired/hostile target, Send_fire(dir), then server combat result; fire does not ask for an ammunition item.

capabilities.title: combat.cancel-fire
capabilities.description: Cancel each fire selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction/acquired/hostile target, Send_fire(dir), then server combat result; fire does not ask for an ammunition item.

capabilities.title: combat.throw
capabilities.description: Choose inventory-first item including equipped weapon, then direction/target; Send_throw encodes dir then signed item. Each canceled step sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.cancel-throw
capabilities.description: Cancel each throw selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose inventory-first item including equipped weapon, then direction/target; Send_throw encodes dir then signed item. Each canceled step sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.steal
capabilities.description: Choose direction then request stealing from server; invalid/canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.cancel-steal
capabilities.description: Cancel each steal selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction then request stealing from server; invalid/canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.spike
capabilities.description: Choose direction then send spike intent; canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.cancel-spike
capabilities.description: Cancel each spike selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction then send spike intent; canceled direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: combat.sip
capabilities.description: Send sip intent without an item selector; server owns fountain outcome.

capabilities.title: combat.telekinesis

capabilities.title: combat.cloak
capabilities.description: Send cloak intent and observe server-owned state; no local success is presumed.

capabilities.title: skills.read-tree
capabilities.description: Read server skill metadata/value/development/flags, points and available activation keys; preserve ordering, hidden/dummy nodes and live updates rather than treating a tree row as a command.

capabilities.title: skills.navigate-tree
capabilities.description: Navigate the skill tree with selection/page/home/end, # line and name search; cancel a search remains in the tree and close restores gameplay.

capabilities.title: skills.raise
capabilities.description: Raise the selected eligible skill via Send_skill_mod; retain points/eligibility and server-authoritative value, including rejection.

capabilities.title: skills.develop
capabilities.description: Expand/collapse one skill branch with Enter, all branches with c/o, preserving dev flags, cursor resets and Send_skill_dev(index,dev) versus (-1,dev); dev here is tree expansion, not spending skill points.

capabilities.title: skills.select-ability
capabilities.description: Select a learned active ability by page letter or @ exact name/number, with list toggle and +/- pages; missing safe-macro choice aborts/flushes and no activation is fabricated.

capabilities.title: skills.cancel-ability
capabilities.description: Escape or canceled/missing named ability returns -1 and restores gameplay with safe macro flushing when required.

capabilities.title: spells.read-metadata
capabilities.description: Read legacy spell bitsets/formatted lines, newer mimic RF4/5/6/0 powers and melee/ranged technique availability without losing raw text or conflating bit indices with visible letters.

capabilities.title: spells.choose-school
capabilities.description: Choose book then school spell; lowercase selects, uppercase describes without casting, list toggles and forced-name/level limit still validate availability. Preserve SFLG1_LIMIT_SPELLS and DISCRETE_SPELL_SYSTEM, returning spell+1000*level and item_book.

capabilities.title: spells.browse-book
capabilities.description: Browse a realm/school book from carried/equipped slot or negative store index; lowercase describes, uppercase school entry pastes to chat and describes, Escape restores the exact caller. Empty custom tome and invalid-book feedback retain their own paths.

capabilities.title: spells.cast-school
capabilities.description: Select school spell and optional direction, Lua extra and item callbacks; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_SCHOOL,item,spell,dir,item_obj,aux) preserves limited spell level and callback overrides. Canceled book/spell/direction aborts; a false extra callback sets aux=0 and canceled item callback retains item_obj=-1 but still sends.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-cast-school
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of cast-school separately. Select school spell and optional direction, Lua extra and item callbacks; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_SCHOOL,item,spell,dir,item_obj,aux) preserves limited spell level and callback overrides. Canceled book/spell/direction aborts; a false extra callback sets aux=0 and canceled item callback retains item_obj=-1 but still sends.

capabilities.title: spells.cast-legacy
capabilities.description: Select an eligible realm book then usable legacy spell; uppercase encodes index+64, not verification. Send_activate_skill uses action_mkey, book and spell; absent usable spells and Escape emit no activation.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-cast-legacy
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of cast-legacy separately. Select an eligible realm book then usable legacy spell; uppercase encodes index+64, not verification. Send_activate_skill uses action_mkey, book and spell; absent usable spells and Escape emit no activation.

capabilities.title: spells.activate-generic
capabilities.description: Use available non-hardcoded skill flags: optional item and optional direction then Send_activate_skill with mkey/book/spell/dir/item/aux. Unknown hardcoded mkey gives newer-client feedback without a packet.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-activate-generic
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of activate-generic separately. Use available non-hardcoded skill flags: optional item and optional direction then Send_activate_skill with mkey/book/spell/dir/item/aux. Unknown hardcoded mkey gives newer-client feedback without a packet.

capabilities.title: spells.ghost
capabilities.description: Choose REALM_GHOST power from server spell metadata, preserving lowercase versus index+64 uppercase; Send_ghost only on valid selection, no usable powers/cancel emits nothing. Ghost capability is separate from death transition.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-ghost
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of ghost separately. Choose REALM_GHOST power from server spell metadata, preserving lowercase versus index+64 uppercase; Send_ghost only on valid selection, no usable powers/cancel emits nothing. Ghost capability is separate from death transition.

capabilities.title: spells.mimic-power
capabilities.description: Select available innate/fixed mimic power by letter or exact case-insensitive name; preserve RF bit correspondence, safe-macro abort and MIMIC_LUA direction metadata. Ordinary powers use Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,...); canceled required direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-mimic-power
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-power separately. Select available innate/fixed mimic power by letter or exact case-insensitive name; preserve RF bit correspondence, safe-macro abort and MIMIC_LUA direction metadata. Ordinary powers use Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,...); canceled required direction sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.mimic-form
capabilities.description: Choose polymorph power then form by name/number (0 player, -1 previous→32767, 20000+race); E40 prompt result boolean is ignored, so Escape after nonempty editing is not automatically no-send. Missing r_info/name produces feedback without cast.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-mimic-form
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-form separately. Choose polymorph power then form by name/number (0 player, -1 previous→32767, 20000+race); E40 prompt result boolean is ignored, so Escape after nonempty editing is not automatically no-send. Missing r_info/name produces feedback without cast.

capabilities.title: spells.mimic-immunity
capabilities.description: On server >4.4.9.1.0.0 choose check/none/electricity/cold/fire/acid/poison/water by letter or ordered substring name; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,0,25000,c,0,0). Escape including name prompt exits without packet.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-mimic-immunity
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-immunity separately. On server >4.4.9.1.0.0 choose check/none/electricity/cold/fire/acid/poison/water by letter or ordered substring name; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,0,25000,c,0,0). Escape including name prompt exits without packet.

capabilities.title: spells.stance
capabilities.description: Choose balanced/defensive/offensive (a/b/c) or previous (-); Send_activate_skill(MKEY_STANCE,stance,0,0,0,0). List toggle preserves choice; Escape sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-stance
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of stance separately. Choose balanced/defensive/offensive (a/b/c) or previous (-); Send_activate_skill(MKEY_STANCE,stance,0,0,0,0). List toggle preserves choice; Escape sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.melee-technique
capabilities.description: Choose available melee technique by bitmask letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Sprint); emit MKEY_MELEE activation, preserving safe macro behavior; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-melee-technique
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of melee-technique separately. Choose available melee technique by bitmask letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Sprint); emit MKEY_MELEE activation, preserving safe macro behavior; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.ranged-technique
capabilities.description: Choose available ranged technique by letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Flare Missile); emit MKEY_RANGED activation; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-ranged-technique
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of ranged-technique separately. Choose available ranged technique by letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Flare Missile); emit MKEY_RANGED activation; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.runecraft
capabilities.description: Compose first rune, second rune, mode and type using shipped rcraft masks/grammar; preserve per-stage list state and optional direction, then send low16/high16 of u in MKEY_RCRAFT activation. Backspace restores previous u; at step zero it exits, Escape/direction cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-runecraft
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of runecraft separately. Compose first rune, second rune, mode and type using shipped rcraft masks/grammar; preserve per-stage list state and optional direction, then send low16/high16 of u in MKEY_RCRAFT activation. Backspace restores previous u; at step zero it exits, Escape/direction cancel sends nothing.

capabilities.title: spells.breath-preference
capabilities.description: For TRAIT_MULTI/POWER choose check/none/element; letters limited to 7 or 13 choices, name substrings have source priority and extended-name behavior. Name Escape returns to the selector (not whole-flow abort); accepted choice sends MKEY_PICK_BREATH.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-breath-preference
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of breath-preference separately. For TRAIT_MULTI/POWER choose check/none/element; letters limited to 7 or 13 choices, name substrings have source priority and extended-name behavior. Name Escape returns to the selector (not whole-flow abort); accepted choice sends MKEY_PICK_BREATH.

capabilities.title: spells.breath
capabilities.description: Choose direction/acquired target and send MKEY_BREATH activation; cancellation sends nothing and restores ability/gameplay parent.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-breath
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of breath separately. Choose direction/acquired target and send MKEY_BREATH activation; cancellation sends nothing and restores ability/gameplay parent.

capabilities.title: spells.trap
capabilities.description: Choose trap kit then matching ammunition/potion/scroll-rune/device load; preserve bag identities and subtype filters, unknown-kit feedback and safe-macro flushing. Send_activate_skill(MKEY_TRAP,item_kit,item_load,0,0,0) only after both choices.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-trap
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of trap separately. Choose trap kit then matching ammunition/potion/scroll-rune/device load; preserve bag identities and subtype filters, unknown-kit feedback and safe-macro flushing. Send_activate_skill(MKEY_TRAP,item_kit,item_load,0,0,0) only after both choices.

capabilities.title: spells.mycorrhiza
capabilities.description: Choose mushroom including eligible bag slot and send MKEY_MYCORRHIZA with item; no fungus/canceled selection emits no activation and flushes safe macro as specified.

capabilities.title: spells.cancel-mycorrhiza
capabilities.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mycorrhiza separately. Choose mushroom including eligible bag slot and send MKEY_MYCORRHIZA with item; no fungus/canceled selection emits no activation and flushes safe macro as specified.

capabilities.title: spells.stop-mycorrhiza
capabilities.description: Stop existing mycorrhiza through MKEY_STOP_MYCORRHIZA dispatch: Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MYCORRHIZA,0,0,0,-1,0), with no item selection.

capabilities.title: store.page
capabilities.description: Page forward/back with wrap or jump to populated numbered page; preserve 12/26 baseline row mapping, invalid empty-page behavior and server action-key priority.

capabilities.title: store.buy
capabilities.description: Select page-relative stock then affordable amount with !G defaults and one-item variant; insufficient gold, empty stock and canceled normal quantity emit no purchase. TV_GOLD pseudo-object quantity is a separate branch and may send zero. Observe server stock and gold result.

capabilities.title: store.take-home
capabilities.description: Take an item from home using stock_top and quantity; home bypasses store-price messaging but retains source affordability check and pseudo-gold branch. Await authoritative inventory/home stock updates.

capabilities.title: store.sell
capabilities.description: Choose owned item and quantity preserving bag/whole-stack/!G semantics; Send_store_sell may receive zero after canceled quantity. Receive_sell supplies offered price; only confirmed sale completes, with authoritative stock/gold updates.

capabilities.title: store.deposit-home
capabilities.description: Select item and amount for home deposit, not a sale offer; Send_store_sell and resulting home/inventory state retain quantity-zero behavior.

capabilities.title: store.deposit-gold
capabilities.description: In STORE_HOME/HOME_DUN prompt gold and send Send_store_sell(9999,amount), including zero on Escape; outside home $ follows raw-key behavior unless server action consumes it.

capabilities.title: store.donate
capabilities.description: Choose item and quantity for Mathom house, default-no Really donate confirmation, then server Receive_sell donation confirmation when requested. Declining either confirmation sends no corresponding transaction/confirm packet.

capabilities.title: store.accept-offer
capabilities.description: Accept offered sale price or donation with default-no confirmation and emit Send_store_confirm once; no_verify_sell immediately confirms. Redraw/repeated view construction cannot resubmit.

capabilities.title: store.decline-offer
capabilities.description: Decline offered sale price/donation: no Send_store_confirm and restore the store parent; do not invent a negative-confirm packet.

capabilities.title: store.examine
capabilities.description: Select displayed stock, resolve absolute index and inspect; normal book path browses locally, while no_browse/one variant forces Send_store_examine. Missing stock/canceled selection leaves store unchanged.

capabilities.title: store.service
capabilities.description: Execute ordinary server-advertised service: BACT_F_STORE_ITEM or inventory tester (ID/star-ID, armour/no-shield/cloak/nonart, weapon/ammo/ranged/melee/trapkit), optional gold flags and default wager, then action/item/item2/amt/gold. Canceled item or zero service gold sends nothing; server validates service/result.

capabilities.title: store.raw-key
capabilities.description: Dispatch unclaimed store key raw after server-letter priority and N/R collision rules; do not reinterpret it through gameplay keymap. CR is ignored; enabled local keys remain local.

capabilities.title: store.paste-stock
capabilities.description: Select stock and compose chat with attributed item name/location, colon escaping, stock/page limits and optional price fields; Escape restores store without chat. Preserve source bytes and bounded expansion.

capabilities.title: store.child-item
capabilities.description: Open inventory/equipment/book/own-item inspection or an allowed item action from shopping; server letters win over local bindings. Child cancellation/completion restores same store/page while live stock updates continue; keep macros_in_stores policy.

capabilities.title: store.cancel-buy

capabilities.title: store.cancel-paste-stock

Select stock and compose chat with attributed item name/location, colon escaping, stock/page limits and optional price fields; Escape restores store without chat. Preserve source bytes and bounded expansion.

capabilities.title: store.transaction-rejected
capabilities.description: Show empty stock, unavailable action, unaffordable quantity or authoritative server refusal without claiming a purchase/sale/service; keep coherent stock/gold and usable store context, and flush safe macro on server kick only according to baseline.

capabilities.title: items.autoinscribe-on-update
capabilities.description: Apply configured local auto-inscription rules when inventory/bag updates or explicit PKT_AUTOINSCRIBE request require it, with force FALSE and original ordering. Request slot byte before 4.9.2.1.0.1 versus i16 later; retain existing-inscription protection and item update eligibility. Load required rule data with profile input; rule editing belongs to E.

capabilities.title: items.details-read
capabilities.description: Read the exact post-wire item-detail title, attributed lines, count, page-size markers and server position. Preserve unknown text and no-wrap source view; do not infer object data from rendered cells.

capabilities.title: items.details-navigate
capabilities.description: Navigate item details by line/page/home/end/goto and horizontal offset, preserving server page requests and cursor updates.

capabilities.title: items.details-search
capabilities.description: Search item details forward/backward by text or gated regexp, retaining search bytes and 251 reverse marker; cancel search returns to perusal with owner-specific regexp behavior.

capabilities.title: items.details-close
capabilities.description: Close item details using SPECIAL_FILE_NONE, clear document state, restore macro policy and the exact originating item/store surface, without repeating observe/examine.

capabilities.description: Use / all-in-one: choose charged/eligible item then dispatch by tval, equipped position and WIELD_BOOKS/WIELD_DEVICES.
