actions.title: Answer key request
actions.description: Submit the selected key to the current request owner.

actions.title: Cancel key request
actions.description: Submit zero for Escape according to get_com and Receive_request_key.

actions.title: Choose advertised server
actions.description: Select a metaserver entry and preserve its endpoint; ping results may update without changing the selected server.

actions.title: Enter an explicit server
actions.description: Enter host and effective port manually or from startup arguments; no hostname-to-IP canonicalization of credential identity.

actions.title: Cancel manual server entry
actions.description: Escape cancels manual entry and follows the startup caller exit path without contacting a guessed/default host.

actions.title: Enter account identity
actions.description: Interactive account name has 15 payload bytes and live trimming; CLI/config producers retain their own boundaries and server validation.

actions.title: Exit account entry
actions.description: Escape from account-name entry exits startup; it does not silently authenticate a stored identity.

actions.title: Enter private login password
actions.description: Accept private password bytes up to 15 interactive payload bytes; empty input retries, no normalization, history or diagnostic capture.

actions.title: Return from password to account name
actions.description: Escape from password entry returns to account-name selection without a login packet.

actions.title: Read account information
actions.description: Read account validation and account information from the account-options surface; Escape returns to the options parent.

actions.title: Submit password change
actions.description: Enter old/new/repeated private passwords, then submit old/new once; successful send immediately updates session/vault secret under the approved policy, separately from later server success messages.

actions.title: Cancel password change
actions.description: Escape at old, new or repeat editor returns to account options without sending or replacing the saved credential.

actions.title: Enter an existing character
actions.description: Select an owned slot by letter and complete login status handling before starting play; command-line/default character selection must resolve identically.

actions.title: Start ordinary character creation
actions.description: N chooses an available ordinary slot; name acceptance starts birth only when server permits creation.

actions.title: Start slot-exclusive character creation
actions.description: E selects dedicated creation when exclusive_ok and not first run; carry dedicated IDDC/PvP mode into completed birth.

actions.title: Name a new character
actions.description: Use 15-byte live-trim/plus-prefix editor; empty entry generates a random suggestion and remains in editor, nonempty accepts, plus prefix requests reincarnation. Server Trim_name and ownership checks remain authoritative.

actions.title: Cancel a new character name
actions.description: Escape returns to character overview with no character-login submission.

actions.title: Swap characters
actions.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 1. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

actions.title: Insert character before another
actions.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 2. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

actions.title: Append character after another
actions.description: Select two valid slots and send PKT_LOGIN with *** followed by first slot, second slot and mode 3. Wait for the refreshed server list before treating ordering as changed.

actions.title: Cancel first reorder selection
actions.description: Escape at first slot selection discards the unfinished reorder and returns to overview without PKT_LOGIN reorder bytes.

actions.title: Cancel second reorder selection
actions.description: Escape at second slot selection discards the unfinished reorder and returns to overview without PKT_LOGIN reorder bytes.

actions.title: Quit from character overview
actions.description: Q or Ctrl-Q exits the overview through the baseline connection cleanup without selecting a character.

actions.title: Choose sex
actions.description: Complete the sex choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Choose race
actions.description: Complete the race choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Choose trait
actions.description: Complete the trait choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Choose class
actions.description: Complete the class choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Choose body modification
actions.description: Complete the body choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Distribute starting stats
actions.description: Complete the stats choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Choose character mode
actions.description: Complete the mode choice with legal server-provided values; preserve highlighted selection, random/DNA choices and legal compatibility checks before advancing.

actions.title: Quit character creation
actions.description: Q or Ctrl-Q terminates creation through baseline quit/retry handling without sending a completed character.

actions.title: Reuse saved birth choices
actions.description: Load character DNA from the shared baseline filename; missing/invalid or incompatible choices cannot bypass legality checks. Preserve # selection and percent auto-reincarnation semantics.

actions.title: Read and acknowledge MOTD
actions.description: Present received MOTD; acknowledge via a nonzero key after the baseline wait, returning to the startup/play-handshake owner before Net_start; gameplay input is not yet enabled.

actions.title: Quit and release the live session
actions.description: Ctrl-Q or window close follows the live quit owner, saves owned profile/history and releases network/input resources; optional save-chat child returns correctly.

actions.title: Leave the tomb screen
actions.description: Escape/q/Q/Ctrl-Q leaves the tomb through its shutdown owner and stops tomb weather/effects; redraw does not repeat disconnect.

actions.title: Review final character state
actions.description: Shutdown review exposes character, inventory, equipment and message/chat history child surfaces and restores the shutdown parent on child close.

actions.title: Confirm suicide
actions.description: Default-no confirmation followed by literal @ submits Send_suicide exactly once; server result controls death transition.

actions.title: Decline suicide
actions.description: Decline or Escape first confirmation, or any second key except @, returns to gameplay without Send_suicide.

actions.title: Walk one step
actions.description: Use command_dir or direction prompt; send one walk intent, observe authoritative movement or blocked result.

actions.title: Run in a direction
actions.description: Send run intent and observe server-controlled continuation/stop; queued movement is not optimistic local position.

actions.title: Stay and pick up
actions.description: Send stay with normal pickup semantics; server pickup confirmation is a separate owner.

actions.title: Pick up one item
actions.description: Send stay-one, preserving its distinction from ordinary stay and automatic stay.

actions.title: Rest
actions.description: Send rest; show server resting state and stop only through baseline interruption/results.

actions.title: Search once
actions.description: Send a single search action and show server result.

actions.title: Toggle searching
actions.description: Send toggle-search and show authoritative search state.

actions.title: Use stairs upward
actions.description: Send upward stair action; server changes location or reports refusal; preserve shipped escape-prefix macro.

actions.title: Use stairs downward
actions.description: Send downward stair action; server changes location or reports refusal; preserve shipped escape-prefix macro.

actions.title: Tunnel in a direction
actions.description: Use resolved direction and send tunnel; server owns obstruction and repeated action semantics.

actions.title: Open adjacent feature
actions.description: Send open with direction; observe door/chest/store entry or denial as server determines.

actions.title: Close adjacent feature
actions.description: Send close with direction and observe close or refusal.

actions.title: Bash adjacent feature
actions.description: Send bash with direction, preserving server failure and side effects.

actions.title: Disarm adjacent feature
actions.description: Send disarm with direction and preserve success/failure/trigger consequences.

actions.title: Cancel a navigation direction
actions.description: Cancel or invalid direction sends no walk/run/tunnel/open/close/bash/disarm packet; exercise each caller independently, including cancellation of nested targeting.

actions.title: Interrupt repeated actions
actions.description: Space clears repeated actions according to process_command; do not equate this with the explicit server buffer-clear command.

actions.title: Clear queued server commands
actions.description: Send_clear_buffer for right parenthesis clears server command queue without executing its contents again on redraw.

actions.title: Open floor or world map
actions.description: Request mode 0 overview or forced world mode 1; display complete map stream and own player-sector marker.

actions.title: Pan the overview
actions.description: Navigation requests retain baseline map direction bitmask; 5/Space/r recenters, with server version and selector-scrolling gates.

actions.title: Inspect a world sector
actions.description: s toggles world-map selector; direction moves bounded sector selection and shows coordinates/distance without moving player.

actions.title: Leave sector selection
actions.description: Escape from selection clears selector while map remains active; another Escape closes map.

actions.title: Close the overview
actions.description: Escape/M exits map, clears local_map_active and restores parent with queue flush; do not resend map commands from redraw.

actions.title: Inspect neighbouring map panels
actions.description: Send_locate(5) opens panel browsing, direction sends panel movement without moving player.

actions.title: Restore player-centred viewport
actions.description: Exit locate with Escape/Space/L (normal) or W (roguelike), send Send_locate(0) and restore prior input policy.

actions.title: Choose a direction for an action
actions.description: Return mapped direction 1..9 to its caller; supplied command_dir bypasses prompt without reading another key.

actions.title: Use the acquired target
actions.description: Minus returns code 10, plus code 11, ordinary 5 returns 5; do not conflate target-required, acquired/manual and self-capable routes.

actions.title: Choose a target from a direction prompt
actions.description: Star opens hostile target child; successful selection returns 5, child cancellation returns no direction and caller must not send its action.

actions.title: Cancel a direction choice
actions.description: Escape/invalid direction returns false, with no enclosing action packet; parent owner decides whether to retry or exit.

actions.title: Select a hostile target
actions.description: Initialize Send_target(0), navigate candidates with mapped direction, accept t/5 using Send_target(5). Server target info supplies result.

actions.title: Select a target position
actions.description: p toggles manual mode and sends target 128; navigation sends 128+direction and acceptance sends 133.

actions.title: Cancel hostile target selection
actions.description: Escape/q or any unmapped non-command key exits false without a target-confirm or invented cancel packet; clear target prompt and return to caller.

actions.title: Acquire a friendly target
actions.description: Friendly command sends Send_target_friendly(0) and returns immediately; no copied hostile modal loop or false cancel obligation.

actions.title: Inspect entities
actions.description: Initialize Send_look(0) and browse directions; invalid direction bells/retries without closing; input updates do not move player.

actions.title: Inspect a ground grid
actions.description: p switches manual ground mode; l (normal) or x (roguelike) sends look 133 only in manual mode.

actions.title: Close inspection
actions.description: Escape/q clears topline and restores previous hybrid-macro policy, including after nested chat; no fabricated close packet.

actions.title: Answer a server direction request
actions.description: PKT_DIRECTION waits while screen/topline/store is busy, then returns selected direction once; keep this owner distinct from generic key requests.

actions.title: Cancel a server direction request
actions.description: Canceled Receive_direction returns without a direction reply; preserve busy-request queue and parent restoration rather than sending generic key zero.

actions.title: Acknowledge the final scene
actions.description: After terminal death/retirement display final scene until literal 0; other keys do not skip this acknowledgement. Then display tomb.

actions.title: Continue from tomb to final review
actions.description: A nonzero key other than tomb quit/dump/screenshot commands enters final review; 0 remains at tomb.

actions.title: Close final review
actions.description: Escape/Ctrl-Q leaves final-state review and continues the disconnect/relogin path.

actions.title: Return from race selection
actions.description: Backspace from race returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: Return from trait selection
actions.description: Backspace from trait returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: Return from class selection
actions.description: Backspace from class returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: Return from body selection
actions.description: Backspace from body returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: Return from stats selection
actions.description: Backspace from stats returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: Return from mode selection
actions.description: Backspace from mode returns to its preceding birth owner; preserve CLASS_BEFORE_RACE ordering, skipped unavailable trait/body steps and post-mode PvP Maia trait return. No completed play packet is sent.

actions.title: items.read-inventory
actions.description: Read inventory slots with original slot identity, names/colour/inscription boundaries, count, weight, type/subtype, identification, artefact, trade and uses_dir metadata. Empty-slot updates remove visible entries; selection never derives identity from sorted display rows.

actions.title: items.read-equipment
actions.description: Read equipment at stable equipment slots, including normal/wide powers, bonuses, set/identification and direction flags; retain old-version defaults and exact source names. Final-state review uses these read-only data without enabling live commands.

actions.title: items.read-bag
actions.description: Read a selected bag and its contents using container slot plus contained slot, preserving the encoded (container+1)*SUBINVEN_INVEN_MUL+slot identity across updates, empty entries and parent closure.

actions.title: items.pickup-accept
actions.description: Accept the server pickup check with default-no confirmation and send Send_stay exactly once; observe authoritative pickup/inventory updates.

actions.title: items.pickup-decline
actions.description: Decline or Escape the pickup check: no Send_stay and no generic request reply; restore the movement owner.

actions.title: store.leave
actions.description: Escape/Ctrl-Q leaves the store, emits Send_store_leave through the store lifecycle, clears transient stock/last selection and restores the previous owner and macro state.

actions.title: items.select-slot
actions.description: Select an eligible inventory/equipment/bag slot via letter, tag digit, sole-item Enter or newest +; / switches inventory/equipment, ! selects bag when permitted. Preserve tester hooks, INVEN_FIRST/UNPREFER_SUBINVEN, charge checks, uppercase verification versus CAPS_ALT and special negative results.

actions.title: items.select-name
actions.description: Resolve @ name lookup against the caller-specific item tester, inscription precedence, matching order and permitted sources; the local 79-byte name is not sent as an item ID.

actions.title: items.cancel-selection
actions.description: Escape or rejected uppercase verification returns failure to the exact item caller and removes the temporary list; safe macro missing-item/tag/name handling flushes only according to safe_macros/abort_prompt, including command_gap and remaining tag/name bytes.

actions.title: items.toggle-selection-list
actions.description: Toggle the eligible item list without changing chosen source or item identity; redraw and updates preserve the pending selector and return owner.

actions.title: items.drop
actions.description: Select item and quantity, preserving equipped ammo, whole_ammo_stack, verified_item and !G defaults. Send_drop still receives zero when the quantity prompt is canceled; item-selector cancellation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-drop
actions.description: Cancel drop at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select item and quantity, preserving equipped ammo, whole_ammo_stack, verified_item and !G defaults. Send_drop still receives zero when the quantity prompt is canceled; item-selector cancellation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.drop-gold
actions.description: Enter a gold amount with all/space handling; nonzero sends gold, zero or canceled quantity sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-drop-gold
actions.description: Cancel drop-gold at each available step and restore its exact caller. Enter a gold amount with all/space handling; nonzero sends gold, zero or canceled quantity sends nothing.

actions.title: items.wield
actions.description: Choose a carried item and send its stable slot to wear/wield; cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-wield
actions.description: Cancel wield at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a carried item and send its stable slot to wear/wield; cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.wield-secondary
actions.description: Choose a carried item for the secondary slot using Send_wield2; cancellation sends nothing and server version support remains explicit.

actions.title: items.cancel-wield-secondary
actions.description: Cancel wield-secondary at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a carried item for the secondary slot using Send_wield2; cancellation sends nothing and server version support remains explicit.

actions.title: items.take-off
actions.description: Select equipped item; ordinary path takes off with Send_take_off. Verified stacks on server >4.4.7.0.0.0 ask quantity and use Send_take_off_amt, including quantity zero; item cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-take-off
actions.description: Cancel take-off at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select equipped item; ordinary path takes off with Send_take_off. Verified stacks on server >4.4.7.0.0.0 ask quantity and use Send_take_off_amt, including quantity zero; item cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.swap
actions.description: Resolve @xN/@N and equipment identities to primary/secondary wield or takeoff; matching dual-wield inscriptions use Send_wield3. Cancel does not swap; all fallback branches remain distinct evidence cases.

actions.title: items.cancel-swap
actions.description: Cancel swap at each available step and restore its exact caller. Resolve @xN/@N and equipment identities to primary/secondary wield or takeoff; matching dual-wield inscriptions use Send_wield3. Cancel does not swap; all fallback branches remain distinct evidence cases.

actions.title: items.destroy
actions.description: Select item, quantity and default-no confirmation unless no_verify_destroy; preserve whole_ammo_stack and bag behavior. Zero quantity, Escape or declined confirmation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-destroy
actions.description: Cancel destroy at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select item, quantity and default-no confirmation unless no_verify_destroy; preserve whole_ammo_stack and bag behavior. Zero quantity, Escape or declined confirmation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.inscribe
actions.description: Choose item then inscription, or SPECIAL_REQ -3 selects inscription first then item. Both editors have 59-byte entry limit; wire %s and server INSCR_LEN bound differ. Cancel at either step sends nothing; accepted empty remains distinct.

actions.title: items.cancel-inscribe
actions.description: Cancel inscribe at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose item then inscription, or SPECIAL_REQ -3 selects inscription first then item. Both editors have 59-byte entry limit; wire %s and server INSCR_LEN bound differ. Cancel at either step sends nothing; accepted empty remains distinct.

actions.title: items.uninscribe
actions.description: Choose item and remove its inscription through Send_uninscribe; cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-uninscribe
actions.description: Cancel uninscribe at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose item and remove its inscription through Send_uninscribe; cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.autoinscribe-one
actions.description: Apply local ordered rules with force TRUE to one selected item, then permitted server fallback if unhandled and uninscribed. Preserve auto_inscr_off, server/chemical flags and server >4.5.5.0.0.0; this does not edit rule files.

actions.title: items.cancel-autoinscribe-one
actions.description: Cancel autoinscribe-one at each available step and restore its exact caller. Apply local ordered rules with force TRUE to one selected item, then permitted server fallback if unhandled and uninscribed. Preserve auto_inscr_off, server/chemical flags and server >4.5.5.0.0.0; this does not edit rule files.

actions.title: items.quaff
actions.description: Choose quaffable potion from allowed inventory/bag, emit Send_quaff and observe server result; empty inventory reports no potions, cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-quaff
actions.description: Cancel quaff at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose quaffable potion from allowed inventory/bag, emit Send_quaff and observe server result; empty inventory reports no potions, cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: items.read
actions.description: Choose scroll, parchment or readable custom object; Send_read can trigger a separate server item/spell request. Cancel/no eligible scroll sends nothing; complete the real child request before claiming this flow.

actions.title: items.cancel-read
actions.description: Cancel read at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose scroll, parchment or readable custom object; Send_read can trigger a separate server item/spell request. Cancel/no eligible scroll sends nothing; complete the real child request before claiming this flow.

actions.title: items.aim-wand
actions.description: Choose charged wand from allowed inventory/equipment then direction/target; canceled item or direction sends no aim. Empty eligible set and server failure preserve parent.

actions.title: items.cancel-aim-wand
actions.description: Cancel aim-wand at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose charged wand from allowed inventory/equipment then direction/target; canceled item or direction sends no aim. Empty eligible set and server failure preserve parent.

actions.title: items.use-staff
actions.description: Choose charged staff from allowed inventory/equipment/bag and emit Send_use; server item selection is a separate required child when requested. Cancel/no eligible staff sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-use-staff
actions.description: Cancel use-staff at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose charged staff from allowed inventory/equipment/bag and emit Send_use; server item selection is a separate required child when requested. Cancel/no eligible staff sends nothing.

actions.title: items.zap-rod
actions.description: Choose a rod; uses_dir=0 (including old-server default) uses Send_zap, otherwise get_dir then Send_zap_dir. Preserve bag identity; canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-zap-rod
actions.description: Cancel zap-rod at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose a rod; uses_dir=0 (including old-server default) uses Send_zap, otherwise get_dir then Send_zap_dir. Preserve bag identity; canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: items.refill
actions.description: Require an equipped light and filter torch versus oil/lantern fuel; choose item and send Send_fill. Missing light or canceled fuel choice sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-refill
actions.description: Cancel refill at each available step and restore its exact caller. Require an equipped light and filter torch versus oil/lantern fuel; choose item and send Send_fill. Missing light or canceled fuel choice sends nothing.

actions.title: items.eat
actions.description: Choose edible food from inventory/bag and send Send_eat; empty eligible set has its own message and cancellation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-eat
actions.description: Cancel eat at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose edible food from inventory/bag and send Send_eat; empty eligible set has its own message and cancellation sends nothing.

actions.title: items.activate
actions.description: Select activatable item, including custom books/runes/chemicals and equipped items; uses_dir=0 sends Send_activate, otherwise direction then Send_activate_dir. Bag chemical selection preserves using_subinven_item for the server child. Cancel direction sends nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-activate
actions.description: Cancel activate at each available step and restore its exact caller. Select activatable item, including custom books/runes/chemicals and equipped items; uses_dir=0 sends Send_activate, otherwise direction then Send_activate_dir. Bag chemical selection preserves using_subinven_item for the server child. Cancel direction sends nothing.

actions.title: items.force-stack
actions.description: Choose ordinary item to force-stack it; stable selected slot goes to Send_force_stack. CAPS_ALT takes the separately allocated split path.

actions.title: items.cancel-force-stack
actions.description: Cancel force-stack at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose ordinary item to force-stack it; stable selected slot goes to Send_force_stack. CAPS_ALT takes the separately allocated split path.

actions.title: items.split-stack
actions.description: Decode CAPS_ALT as -item-2, require stack >=2, select quantity with !G/defaults, clamp below whole stack and emit Send_split_stack. Nothing-to-split and canceled quantity send nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-split-stack
actions.description: Cancel split-stack at each available step and restore its exact caller. Decode CAPS_ALT as -item-2, require stack >=2, select quantity with !G/defaults, clamp below whole stack and emit Send_split_stack. Nothing-to-split and canceled quantity send nothing.

actions.title: items.stow
actions.description: Require a bag, choose carried item and amount with whole-stack/!G rules, then Send_si_move. Missing bag and canceled quantity send nothing.

actions.title: items.cancel-stow
actions.description: Cancel stow at each available step and restore its exact caller. Require a bag, choose carried item and amount with whole-stack/!G rules, then Send_si_move. Missing bag and canceled quantity send nothing.

actions.title: items.unstow
actions.description: Choose contained item and amount, preserving container identity; Send_si_remove only after nonzero quantity. Restore bag owner on cancellation.

actions.title: items.cancel-unstow
actions.description: Cancel unstow at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose contained item and amount, preserving container identity; Send_si_remove only after nonzero quantity. Restore bag owner on cancellation.

actions.title: items.inspect
actions.description: Choose an eligible item and request its details with Send_observe. Retain original attributed server document and return to the invoking inventory/equipment/store/gameplay owner after perusal; item selection alone is insufficient evidence.

actions.title: items.cancel-inspect
actions.description: Cancel inspect at each available step and restore its exact caller. Choose an eligible item and request its details with Send_observe. Retain original attributed server document and return to the invoking inventory/equipment/store/gameplay owner after perusal; item selection alone is insufficient evidence.

actions.title: items.assign-newest
actions.description: Use /new (case-insensitive exact) interactive selector or case-sensitive /new <slot> branch, help/? and first-byte-only parsing. Reject invalid/empty/subinventory result at this owner despite selector availability; assignment is local and redraw-only.

actions.title: items.autoinscribe-all
actions.description: /aai or /apply_auto_inscriptions (case-insensitive exact) applies ordered rules to inventory/equipment and enabled bags without confirmation. Local-off still permits configured server fallback; preserve disabled/bag-only/regex/force overwrite rules and inscription/uninscription packets.

actions.title: items.server-item-answer
actions.description: Complete the owner selection and emit the typed reply once. ITH tester hooks include recharge, armour/weapon/no-shield/nonartefact, ID/star-ID, custom tome, rune equip-only, chemical and signed weight byte. New shape >4.5.2.0.0.0 includes th; old defaults ITH_NONE. Busy queues exact packet; bag chemical exception may enter immediately.

actions.title: items.server-item-cancel
actions.description: Escape/canceled selector returns consumed (1) without any reply; do not send key-zero or a generic request sentinel. ITH tester hooks include recharge, armour/weapon/no-shield/nonartefact, ID/star-ID, custom tome, rune equip-only, chemical and signed weight byte. New shape >4.5.2.0.0.0 includes th; old defaults ITH_NONE. Busy queues exact packet; bag chemical exception may enter immediately.

actions.title: items.server-spell-answer
actions.description: Complete the owner selection and emit the typed reply once. Receive PKT_SPELL i32 book/item; school selection returns item and spell/level semantics to Send_spell (two i16 fields). Busy surface queues the request intact.

actions.title: items.server-spell-cancel
actions.description: Escape/canceled selector returns consumed (1) without any reply; do not send key-zero or a generic request sentinel. Receive PKT_SPELL i32 book/item; school selection returns item and spell/level semantics to Send_spell (two i16 fields). Busy surface queues the request intact.

actions.title: combat.fire
actions.description: Choose direction/acquired/hostile target, Send_fire(dir), then server combat result; fire does not ask for an ammunition item.

actions.title: combat.cancel-fire
actions.description: Cancel each fire selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction/acquired/hostile target, Send_fire(dir), then server combat result; fire does not ask for an ammunition item.

actions.title: combat.throw
actions.description: Choose inventory-first item including equipped weapon, then direction/target; Send_throw encodes dir then signed item. Each canceled step sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.cancel-throw
actions.description: Cancel each throw selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose inventory-first item including equipped weapon, then direction/target; Send_throw encodes dir then signed item. Each canceled step sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.steal
actions.description: Choose direction then request stealing from server; invalid/canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.cancel-steal
actions.description: Cancel each steal selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction then request stealing from server; invalid/canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.spike
actions.description: Choose direction then send spike intent; canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.cancel-spike
actions.description: Cancel each spike selection/direction/target step without sending the final combat intent; restore parent and safe macro policy. Choose direction then send spike intent; canceled direction sends nothing.

actions.title: combat.sip
actions.description: Send sip intent without an item selector; server owns fountain outcome.

actions.title: combat.telekinesis
actions.description: Send telekinesis intent without inventing local prompts; server may request an item/target as its own child.

actions.title: combat.cloak
actions.description: Send cloak intent and observe server-owned state; no local success is presumed.

actions.title: skills.navigate-tree
actions.description: Navigate the skill tree with selection/page/home/end, # line and name search; cancel a search remains in the tree and close restores gameplay.

actions.title: skills.raise
actions.description: Raise the selected eligible skill via Send_skill_mod; retain points/eligibility and server-authoritative value, including rejection.

actions.title: skills.develop
actions.description: Expand/collapse one skill branch with Enter, all branches with c/o, preserving dev flags, cursor resets and Send_skill_dev(index,dev) versus (-1,dev); dev here is tree expansion, not spending skill points.

actions.title: skills.select-ability
actions.description: Select a learned active ability by page letter or @ exact name/number, with list toggle and +/- pages; missing safe-macro choice aborts/flushes and no activation is fabricated.

actions.title: skills.cancel-ability
actions.description: Escape or canceled/missing named ability returns -1 and restores gameplay with safe macro flushing when required.

actions.title: spells.choose-school
actions.description: Choose book then school spell; lowercase selects, uppercase describes without casting, list toggles and forced-name/level limit still validate availability. Preserve SFLG1_LIMIT_SPELLS and DISCRETE_SPELL_SYSTEM, returning spell+1000*level and item_book.

actions.title: spells.browse-book
actions.description: Browse a realm/school book from carried/equipped slot or negative store index; lowercase describes, uppercase school entry pastes to chat and describes, Escape restores the exact caller. Empty custom tome and invalid-book feedback retain their own paths.

actions.title: spells.cast-school
actions.description: Select school spell and optional direction, Lua extra and item callbacks; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_SCHOOL,item,spell,dir,item_obj,aux) preserves limited spell level and callback overrides. Canceled book/spell/direction aborts; a false extra callback sets aux=0 and canceled item callback retains item_obj=-1 but still sends.

actions.title: spells.cancel-cast-school
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of cast-school separately. Select school spell and optional direction, Lua extra and item callbacks; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_SCHOOL,item,spell,dir,item_obj,aux) preserves limited spell level and callback overrides. Canceled book/spell/direction aborts; a false extra callback sets aux=0 and canceled item callback retains item_obj=-1 but still sends.

actions.title: spells.cast-legacy
actions.description: Select an eligible realm book then usable legacy spell; uppercase encodes index+64, not verification. Send_activate_skill uses action_mkey, book and spell; absent usable spells and Escape emit no activation.

actions.title: spells.cancel-cast-legacy
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of cast-legacy separately. Select an eligible realm book then usable legacy spell; uppercase encodes index+64, not verification. Send_activate_skill uses action_mkey, book and spell; absent usable spells and Escape emit no activation.

actions.title: spells.activate-generic
actions.description: Use available non-hardcoded skill flags: optional item and optional direction then Send_activate_skill with mkey/book/spell/dir/item/aux. Unknown hardcoded mkey gives newer-client feedback without a packet.

actions.title: spells.cancel-activate-generic
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of activate-generic separately. Use available non-hardcoded skill flags: optional item and optional direction then Send_activate_skill with mkey/book/spell/dir/item/aux. Unknown hardcoded mkey gives newer-client feedback without a packet.

actions.title: spells.ghost
actions.description: Choose REALM_GHOST power from server spell metadata, preserving lowercase versus index+64 uppercase; Send_ghost only on valid selection, no usable powers/cancel emits nothing. Ghost capability is separate from death transition.

actions.title: spells.cancel-ghost
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of ghost separately. Choose REALM_GHOST power from server spell metadata, preserving lowercase versus index+64 uppercase; Send_ghost only on valid selection, no usable powers/cancel emits nothing. Ghost capability is separate from death transition.

actions.title: spells.mimic-power
actions.description: Select available innate/fixed mimic power by letter or exact case-insensitive name; preserve RF bit correspondence, safe-macro abort and MIMIC_LUA direction metadata. Ordinary powers use Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,...); canceled required direction sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.cancel-mimic-power
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-power separately. Select available innate/fixed mimic power by letter or exact case-insensitive name; preserve RF bit correspondence, safe-macro abort and MIMIC_LUA direction metadata. Ordinary powers use Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,...); canceled required direction sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.mimic-form
actions.description: Choose polymorph power then form by name/number (0 player, -1 previous→32767, 20000+race); E40 prompt result boolean is ignored, so Escape after nonempty editing is not automatically no-send. Missing r_info/name produces feedback without cast.

actions.title: spells.cancel-mimic-form
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-form separately. Choose polymorph power then form by name/number (0 player, -1 previous→32767, 20000+race); E40 prompt result boolean is ignored, so Escape after nonempty editing is not automatically no-send. Missing r_info/name produces feedback without cast.

actions.title: spells.mimic-immunity
actions.description: On server >4.4.9.1.0.0 choose check/none/electricity/cold/fire/acid/poison/water by letter or ordered substring name; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,0,25000,c,0,0). Escape including name prompt exits without packet.

actions.title: spells.cancel-mimic-immunity
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mimic-immunity separately. On server >4.4.9.1.0.0 choose check/none/electricity/cold/fire/acid/poison/water by letter or ordered substring name; Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MIMICRY,0,25000,c,0,0). Escape including name prompt exits without packet.

actions.title: spells.stance
actions.description: Choose balanced/defensive/offensive (a/b/c) or previous (-); Send_activate_skill(MKEY_STANCE,stance,0,0,0,0). List toggle preserves choice; Escape sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.cancel-stance
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of stance separately. Choose balanced/defensive/offensive (a/b/c) or previous (-); Send_activate_skill(MKEY_STANCE,stance,0,0,0,0). List toggle preserves choice; Escape sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.melee-technique
actions.description: Choose available melee technique by bitmask letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Sprint); emit MKEY_MELEE activation, preserving safe macro behavior; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.cancel-melee-technique
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of melee-technique separately. Choose available melee technique by bitmask letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Sprint); emit MKEY_MELEE activation, preserving safe macro behavior; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.ranged-technique
actions.description: Choose available ranged technique by letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Flare Missile); emit MKEY_RANGED activation; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.cancel-ranged-technique
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of ranged-technique separately. Choose available ranged technique by letter or exact case-insensitive name (default Flare Missile); emit MKEY_RANGED activation; canceled name/choice sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.runecraft
actions.description: Compose first rune, second rune, mode and type using shipped rcraft masks/grammar; preserve per-stage list state and optional direction, then send low16/high16 of u in MKEY_RCRAFT activation. Backspace restores previous u; at step zero it exits, Escape/direction cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.cancel-runecraft
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of runecraft separately. Compose first rune, second rune, mode and type using shipped rcraft masks/grammar; preserve per-stage list state and optional direction, then send low16/high16 of u in MKEY_RCRAFT activation. Backspace restores previous u; at step zero it exits, Escape/direction cancel sends nothing.

actions.title: spells.breath-preference
actions.description: For TRAIT_MULTI/POWER choose check/none/element; letters limited to 7 or 13 choices, name substrings have source priority and extended-name behavior. Name Escape returns to the selector (not whole-flow abort); accepted choice sends MKEY_PICK_BREATH.

actions.title: spells.cancel-breath-preference
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of breath-preference separately. For TRAIT_MULTI/POWER choose check/none/element; letters limited to 7 or 13 choices, name substrings have source priority and extended-name behavior. Name Escape returns to the selector (not whole-flow abort); accepted choice sends MKEY_PICK_BREATH.

actions.title: spells.breath
actions.description: Choose direction/acquired target and send MKEY_BREATH activation; cancellation sends nothing and restores ability/gameplay parent.

actions.title: spells.cancel-breath
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of breath separately. Choose direction/acquired target and send MKEY_BREATH activation; cancellation sends nothing and restores ability/gameplay parent.

actions.title: spells.trap
actions.description: Choose trap kit then matching ammunition/potion/scroll-rune/device load; preserve bag identities and subtype filters, unknown-kit feedback and safe-macro flushing. Send_activate_skill(MKEY_TRAP,item_kit,item_load,0,0,0) only after both choices.

actions.title: spells.cancel-trap
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of trap separately. Choose trap kit then matching ammunition/potion/scroll-rune/device load; preserve bag identities and subtype filters, unknown-kit feedback and safe-macro flushing. Send_activate_skill(MKEY_TRAP,item_kit,item_load,0,0,0) only after both choices.

actions.title: spells.mycorrhiza
actions.description: Choose mushroom including eligible bag slot and send MKEY_MYCORRHIZA with item; no fungus/canceled selection emits no activation and flushes safe macro as specified.

actions.title: spells.cancel-mycorrhiza
actions.description: Exercise each cancel/backtrack boundary of mycorrhiza separately. Choose mushroom including eligible bag slot and send MKEY_MYCORRHIZA with item; no fungus/canceled selection emits no activation and flushes safe macro as specified.

actions.title: spells.stop-mycorrhiza
actions.description: Stop existing mycorrhiza through MKEY_STOP_MYCORRHIZA dispatch: Send_activate_skill(MKEY_MYCORRHIZA,0,0,0,-1,0), with no item selection.

actions.title: store.page
actions.description: Page forward/back with wrap or jump to populated numbered page; preserve 12/26 baseline row mapping, invalid empty-page behavior and server action-key priority.

actions.title: store.buy
actions.description: Select page-relative stock then affordable amount with !G defaults and one-item variant; insufficient gold, empty stock and canceled normal quantity emit no purchase. TV_GOLD pseudo-object quantity is a separate branch and may send zero. Observe server stock and gold result.

actions.title: store.take-home
actions.description: Take an item from home using stock_top and quantity; home bypasses store-price messaging but retains source affordability check and pseudo-gold branch. Await authoritative inventory/home stock updates.

actions.title: store.sell
actions.description: Choose owned item and quantity preserving bag/whole-stack/!G semantics; Send_store_sell may receive zero after canceled quantity. Receive_sell supplies offered price; only confirmed sale completes, with authoritative stock/gold updates.

actions.title: store.deposit-home
actions.description: Select item and amount for home deposit, not a sale offer; Send_store_sell and resulting home/inventory state retain quantity-zero behavior.

actions.title: store.deposit-gold
actions.description: In STORE_HOME/HOME_DUN prompt gold and send Send_store_sell(9999,amount), including zero on Escape; outside home $ follows raw-key behavior unless server action consumes it.

actions.title: store.donate
actions.description: Choose item and quantity for Mathom house, default-no Really donate confirmation, then server Receive_sell donation confirmation when requested. Declining either confirmation sends no corresponding transaction/confirm packet.

actions.title: store.accept-offer
actions.description: Accept offered sale price or donation with default-no confirmation and emit Send_store_confirm once; no_verify_sell immediately confirms. Redraw/repeated view construction cannot resubmit.

actions.title: store.decline-offer
actions.description: Decline offered sale price/donation: no Send_store_confirm and restore the store parent; do not invent a negative-confirm packet.

actions.title: store.examine
actions.description: Select displayed stock, resolve absolute index and inspect; normal book path browses locally, while no_browse/one variant forces Send_store_examine. Missing stock/canceled selection leaves store unchanged.

actions.title: store.service
actions.description: Execute ordinary server-advertised service: BACT_F_STORE_ITEM or inventory tester (ID/star-ID, armour/no-shield/cloak/nonart, weapon/ammo/ranged/melee/trapkit), optional gold flags and default wager, then action/item/item2/amt/gold. Canceled item or zero service gold sends nothing; server validates service/result.

actions.title: store.raw-key
actions.description: Dispatch unclaimed store key raw after server-letter priority and N/R collision rules; do not reinterpret it through gameplay keymap. CR is ignored; enabled local keys remain local.

actions.title: store.paste-stock
actions.description: Select stock and compose chat with attributed item name/location, colon escaping, stock/page limits and optional price fields; Escape restores store without chat. Preserve source bytes and bounded expansion.

actions.title: store.child-item
actions.description: Open inventory/equipment/book/own-item inspection or an allowed item action from shopping; server letters win over local bindings. Child cancellation/completion restores same store/page while live stock updates continue; keep macros_in_stores policy.

actions.title: store.cancel-buy
actions.description: Cancel buy at every owned selector/quantity/confirmation step and restore the same store/page unless kicked. Select page-relative stock then affordable amount with !G defaults and one-item variant; insufficient gold, empty stock and canceled normal quantity emit no purchase. TV_GOLD pseudo-object quantity is a separate branch and may send zero. Observe server stock and gold result.

actions.title: store.cancel-take-home
actions.description: Cancel take-home at every owned selector/quantity/confirmation step and restore the same store/page unless kicked. Take an item from home using stock_top and quantity; home bypasses store-price messaging but retains source affordability check and pseudo-gold branch. Await authoritative inventory/home stock updates.

actions.title: store.cancel-sell

Choose owned item and quantity preserving bag/whole-stack/!G semantics; Send_store_sell may receive zero after canceled quantity. Receive_sell supplies offered price; only confirmed sale completes, with authoritative stock/gold updates.

actions.title: store.cancel-deposit-home
actions.description: Cancel deposit-home at every owned selector/quantity/confirmation step and restore the same store/page unless kicked. Select item and amount for home deposit, not a sale offer; Send_store_sell and resulting home/inventory state retain quantity-zero behavior.

actions.title: store.cancel-deposit-gold
actions.description: Cancel deposit-gold at every owned selector/quantity/confirmation step and restore the same store/page unless kicked. In STORE_HOME/HOME_DUN prompt gold and send Send_store_sell(9999,amount), including zero on Escape; outside home $ follows raw-key behavior unless server action consumes it.

Select displayed stock, resolve absolute index and inspect; normal book path browses locally, while no_browse/one variant forces Send_store_examine. Missing stock/canceled selection leaves store unchanged.

Execute ordinary server-advertised service: BACT_F_STORE_ITEM or inventory tester (ID/star-ID, armour/no-shield/cloak/nonart, weapon/ammo/ranged/melee/trapkit), optional gold flags and default wager, then action/item/item2/amt/gold. actions.title: items.details-navigate
actions.description: Navigate item details by line/page/home/end/goto and horizontal offset, preserving server page requests and cursor updates.

actions.title: items.details-search
actions.description: Search item details forward/backward by text or gated regexp, retaining search bytes and 251 reverse marker; cancel search returns to perusal with owner-specific regexp behavior.

actions.title: items.details-close
actions.description: Close item details using SPECIAL_FILE_NONE, clear document state, restore macro policy and the exact originating item/store surface, without repeating observe/examine.

actions.title: items.use-selected
actions.description: Use / all-in-one: choose charged/eligible item then dispatch by tval, equipped position and WIELD_BOOKS/WIELD_DEVICES. Cover quaff/read/aim/use/zap, light fill-or-wield, oil, food/firestone, ammo/equipment wield, spike direction (no item in packet), trap load, rune/chemical/bottle activation, bag browse and book skill/default activation. Bag rod uses Send_zap directly; bag flask/default may return, TV_SPECIAL is a no-op. Cancel any required selection/direction restores parent without final intent.

actions.title: items.cancel-use-selected
actions.description: Cancel the initial all-in-one selector, nested trap/book/skill or required direction using that exact child contract. No direct command is emitted after canceled initial selection; retain school Lua item-cancel still-send semantics after a selected book.

actions.title: items.close-inventory
actions.description: Close the inventory view with Escape/default exit and restore the exact gameplay/store/final-review parent; clear list flags, bag redirection when applicable and flush queue according to this owner. Live command cases may continue in the list; this is not a one-key universal close.

actions.title: items.paste-inventory
actions.description: Paste the selected inventory item directly via uppercase slot or newest +; preserve source name/color, colon escaping, and KIND_DIZ/CLIENT_ITEM_PASTE_DIZ versus SERVER_ITEM_PASTE_DIZ flags and metadata. Empty slot sends nothing; preserve this owner’s exit/continue behavior, not a generic compose prompt.

actions.title: items.close-equipment

actions.title: items.paste-equipment

actions.title: items.close-bag
actions.description: Close the bag view with Escape/default exit and restore the exact gameplay/store/final-review parent; clear list flags, bag redirection when applicable and flush queue according to this owner. Live command cases may continue in the list; this is not a one-key universal close.

actions.title: items.paste-bag
actions.description: Paste the selected bag item directly via uppercase slot; preserve source name/color, colon escaping, and KIND_DIZ/CLIENT_ITEM_PASTE_DIZ versus SERVER_ITEM_PASTE_DIZ flags and metadata. Empty slot sends nothing; preserve this owner’s exit/continue behavior, not a generic compose prompt.
